_doc: Referee round, step 2 (referee-adjudication skill): one adjudicator per referee report, each a fresh read-only
reviewer with the snapshot, the report, the Lean and the dependency database. The adjudication is saved as
Copy this file to <working repository>/rollout/, replace every SET-ME value, run with --dry-run first.

vars.snapshot: SET-ME: the frozen snapshot the referees read
vars.referees: SET-ME: the workdir of the referee run
vars.lean: SET-ME: the Lean source at the pinned commit
vars.graph_db: SET-ME: the dependency database built by lean-dependency-graph
vars.graph_hint: query the dependency database with sqlite3 -readonly {{graph_db}} (table nodes: name, kind, module, path, line, used); only rows with used = 1 count
vars.paper: a natural-language proof, written by AI agents, of the theorem of a completed Lean development
vars.constraints: the literal formal main theorem must not change; the natural main theorem keeps its approved wording; a statement has at most 150 words and 4 references, a definition at most 200 words and 6 references
